info.name: Product API Lab
info.description:
REST API to manage products, currencies and product prices in different currencies.

Run the folders in order (or the whole collection with the Collection Runner):
1. **Auth** logs in as editor and viewer and stores both tokens.
2. **Products** and **Prices** create and update a product and store its id in `{{productId}}`.
3. **Error examples** show the 401, 403, 404 and 422 responses.
4. **Cleanup** deletes the created product and revokes the tokens.

Set `baseUrl` to your environment. The demo passwords are the local defaults; use the ones given for the deployed demo.
Full reference: the OpenAPI specification at `/docs`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Log in to get a Bearer token. The login requests store the tokens in the collection variables automatically.

request.description: Editor token with the `products:write` ability. Stored in `{{token}}`.
Read-only token without abilities. Stored in `{{viewerToken}}`; write requests with it return 403.
Returns the owner of the current token.

item.description: Valid `currency_id` values for products and prices.

request.description: All currencies ordered by ISO code. `exchange_rate` is the amount equivalent to 1 USD.
